hero.intro: Tenth-semester Systems Engineering student with hands-on frontend and backend web development experience.

about.title: Professional profile
about.text: Tenth-semester Systems Engineering student with practical experience in frontend and backend web development using JavaScript, React, Node.js, and Express. Experienced in building and maintaining REST APIs, developing interfaces with Material UI (MUI), validating data with Joi, documenting services with Swagger, and version control with Git and GitHub. Knowledge of MySQL and SQL Server databases, as well as Python, PHP, Laravel, and Django. Also familiar with computer maintenance, networking, and information security fundamentals. Recognized for teamwork, adaptability, and effective communication. English: B1.

experience.title: Work experience
responsibilities: Developed and maintained backend features with Node.js and Express using an organized architecture of models, services, controllers, and DTOs.
Developed and refined frontend interfaces with React and Material UI (MUI), improving visual presentation, themes, and responsive behavior across screen sizes.
Documented REST APIs with Swagger, including endpoints and technical documentation to support system understanding and maintenance.
achievements: Helped improve backend organization and maintainability by separating responsibilities and using libraries such as Joi for data validation.
Implemented visual refinements and responsive styling improvements in React and MUI applications, supporting a more consistent interface.
Applied development practices with Git and GitHub, using branching strategies to organize changes and maintain code traceability.
Strengthened technical documentation for backend services with Swagger, making application endpoints easier to find and understand.
